newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy diesel for May delivery.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy diesel for May delivery.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for May deliveries, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 0.5 and 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for 45,000-tonne cargoes to be delivered to Kandla, on the Indian west coast as well as to Madras/Haldia on the east coast.
It also seeks 30,000-tonne parcels for delivery to Goa/Kandla.
The tender closes on March 20 and offers will be valid for one day.
IOC bought a total of 705,000 tonnes of diesel for April deliveries in two cargoes.
